set.body:
Two gaps in interview/scoring/Scoring.scala (verified 8a455fcb):
1. InductionResult.specificity (induce.scala:124) is computed per DetailId, but Profile (Scoring.scala:347) publishes no specificity figure, so induced specificity never reaches the profile.
2. CoveredScore (Scoring.scala:331) carries only estimate and coverage; no profile figure can be traced to the DetailIds/unit ids that contributed. The promised ProfileStrand (comment at :328) was never built.
Acceptance: Profile publishes a specificity CoveredScore with declared grain and denominator (Missing, never 0, on empty support); every Profile figure exposes its contributing ids (ProfileStrand or equivalent), so that a test recomputes each figure from its contributors alone; a mutation dropping one contributor fails a named test. The stale comment at :328-329 is removed or made true. Gate: interview JVM/JS/Native + codec if serialized.
